title: Irish Lamb Bao
description: A delicious and flavorful bao filled with slow-cooked Irish lamb, perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the minced garlic and chopped onion to the pot, cooking until the onion is translucent.
Add the Irish stout beer to the pot, scraping up any browned bits.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and slow-cook the lamb for 2-3 hours, or until tender.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the bao dough according to package instructions.
Form the dough into small balls and let rest for 10 minutes.
Punch down the dough and roll out into thin circles.
Place a spoonful of the lamb mixture onto one half of the dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to enclose the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Repeat with the remaining dough and lamb mixture.
Cook the bao on a baking sheet in a preheated oven at 400°F (200°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until golden brown.
